answer:
**Root cause:** the `checkout` container of Deployment `missing-env-1101-120000` (namespace `triage-lab`) exits with code 1 because `DATABASE_URL` is not set; it reads its environment from ConfigMap `missing-env-1101-120000-config`, which only has `PAYMENTS_URL`.

**Fix:** add the variable and restart:
```
kubectl patch configmap missing-env-1101-120000-config -n triage-lab --type merge -p '{"data":{"DATABASE_URL":"postgres://orders:orders@orders-db.triage-lab.svc:5432/orders"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/missing-env-1101-120000 -n triage-lab
```
